captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, printable chain of interconnected triangular panels forming a customizable hexaflexagon. The panels feature rounded edges and are linked together via integrated hinge pins and matching cutouts, allowing them to fold dynamically. Embossed lettering is visible on both the top and bottom faces of each triangle, spelling out segmented words when folded correctly. The entire assembly is printed flat as a single continuous strip of repeating triangular links.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable hexaflexagon that displays three-word messages across its faces. The model should consist of a series of triangular panels connected by integrated print-in-place hinges, with parameters to adjust the words, triangle edge length, height, and hinge tolerance.
captions.factory: The design uses a main 'hexaflexaword' module that arranges several 'pair' and 'single' modules. Each triangular panel ('tri') is built from a central polygon prism extruded using 'linear_extrude' and three rounded edges ('triEdge') made of cylinders and spheres. Hinges are created by subtracting 'triHingeCutout' (using cubes and cylinders) and adding 'linkPin' connectors. Text characters from a custom font are mapped to polygon coordinates, scaled, extruded, and subtracted from the top and bottom faces via 'topBadge' and 'bottomBadge' modules.
